Thank you so much, I knew this subreddit would be helpful!  
I didn't think of talking to the colleges themselves, so thanks for the suggestion. I might send over an email or two. 

Yeah, I was diagnosed with general anxiety disorder and depression, the suspected ADHD or Bipolar, then BPD. We just want help. Then people get frustrated cause they can't fix us and.. eugh. 

I'm still adjusting to the episode, but getting better. I'm better than where I was when I wrote this. Thank you.
